name: Skill Editing and Commit
description: Workflow for editing skill files and committing changes to GitHub via API. This is a cross-scope workflow spanning principal-ade-main and principal-ade-principal-window processes.

scenarios.description: User successfully edits a skill file and commits to GitHub

events.skill.editor.opened: Opened editor for **{{skill.name}}** ({{repository.owner}}/{{repository.name}}, {{file.count}} files, branch: {{repository.branch}}, session: {{session.id}})
events.skill.file.loaded: Loaded **{{file.path}}** in skill **{{skill.name}}** ({{file.size.bytes}} bytes, extension: {{file.extension}}, editor: {{editor.type}}, {{duration.ms}}ms, session: {{session.id}})
events.skill.file.edited: Modified **{{file.path}}** in skill **{{skill.name}}** (dirty: {{is.dirty}}, content length: {{content.length}} chars, session: {{session.id}})
events.skill.commit.started: Commit "{{commit.message}}" started for **{{file.path}}** in skill **{{skill.name}}** (message length: {{commit_message_length}} chars, session: {{session.id}})
events.github.api.commit.request: Committing to {{repository.owner}}/{{repository.name}}:{{repository.branch}} at **{{file.path}}** ({{http.method}}, file SHA: {{file.sha}}, session: {{session.id}})
events.github.api.commit.response: GitHub responded: status {{http.status_code}} (success: **{{success}}**, commit SHA: {{commit.sha}}, error: {{error.type}} - {{error.message}}, {{duration.ms}}ms, session: {{session.id}})
events.skill.file.updated: Updated local file **{{file.path}}** at {{local.path}} ({{file.size.bytes}} bytes, skill: {{skill.name}}, session: {{session.id}})
events.skill.lock.updated: Updated lock for **{{skill.name}}** (old SHA: {{old.commit.sha}}, new SHA: {{new.commit.sha}}, at: {{updated.at}}, session: {{session.id}})

events.skill.update.checked: Checked for affected skills (repository: {{repository.full_name}}, branch: {{repository.branch}}, found: **{{affected.skill.count}}** skills, delivery: {{webhook.delivery.id}})
events.skill.update.notification.created: Created update notification for **{{skill.name}}** (repo: {{repository.full_name}}, branch: {{repository.branch}}, type: {{notification.type}}, ID: {{notification.id}}, delivery: {{webhook.delivery.id}})
